about.title: About Global Ship Services
text: We are a well-reputed Ship Chandler based in the U.S. and Global with 50 years of industry experience. With warehouses across the U.S. Gulf Coast and Middle East. We proudly serve thousands of vessels every year.

Global Ship Services operates in major U.S. ports including Houston, New Orleans, and Corpus Christi, Jeddah, Fujairah, we also maintaining a strong international presence with our partner in South America, Asia and partners across Africa and many more.
We provide comprehensive marine solutions including Ship Provisions & Stores, Bonded Stores, Deck & Engine Supplies, Ship Repairs & Maintenance, and Cash to Master (CTM) services.
